title: 第2276章 仙道神源第2275章 只求一死
slug: 反派不朽帝族族人竟都是老六
content_zh:
面对影魔族领头强者的嘶吼，江尘并未做出回应，他心念一动，涌向对方的神魂之力再次增强一截。
“啊……”
在江尘神魂之力疯狂冲击下，影魔族领头强者凄厉惨叫，只不过声音越来越小，眼神更是逐渐变得呆滞。
片刻过后，影魔族领头强者不再惨叫，而他双眸更是变得一片空洞，看起来就如同是一具行尸走肉。
在得对方魂海内有禁制后，江尘便放弃了搜魂这一手段，他直接利用自身神魂之力冲击对方，让他陷入失神状态。
在如此状态下，江尘只需借助神魂之力稍加引导，便可得知自己想要的消息。
扫了影魔族领头强者一眼，江尘沉声开口询问：“各大神魔势力如此大张旗鼓，到底是在寻找什么？”
江尘询问的话语一出口，略显生硬的声音从影魔族领头强者口中传出：“我等是在寻找天妖族强者。”
闻听此言，江尘面露惊讶之色。
当初与神主的那一战，天妖族更是损失两名神帝境长老，最后肉身更是被神灵族长老夺舍，没想到这么快又派人来了。
稍微一想，江尘也就了然了。
两名神帝长老折损在神澜仙界，对方定然不会善罢甘休，派人上来也正常，只不过江尘没想到会如此之快。
江道心二人一听与天妖族有关，面色也变得凝重了起来。
江尘继续追问：“你们寻找天妖族所为何事，是想与对方合作对付我等吗？”
影魔族强者摇了摇头，回道：“我等寻找天妖一族，是想向黑蛟族交投名状。”
“木神族已联系上黑蛟族，打算借助黑蛟族的力量对你等出手，之所以寻找天妖族，是因为他们是黑蛟族死对头。”
“木神族传出明确消息，黑蛟族这次派出了三尊神帝强者，不久便可到达神澜仙界，各大势力都想好好表现一下……”
在失神状态下，影魔族强者没有丝毫隐瞒，将自己所知道的消息，一股脑尽数告知了江尘。
“什么，三尊神帝强者？”
随着影魔族领头强者话音一落，江道心忍不住惊呼出声。

突然跳出个黑蛟族就罢了，还一次性动用三尊神帝强者，江道心内心震惊不已。
饶是江尘在得知此消息后，神情也无法继续保持平静，如今小天刚掌控神澜仙界不久，天道压制并未完全掌控。
三尊神帝强者前来，到时他们进入神澜仙界后，力量怕是不会被削弱太多。
若对方依旧能发挥神帝修为，对自己等人而言将是一场灾难。
域外神帝强者，纵然江尘三人皆凝聚出神纹，怕是也奈何不了对方。
更何况天妖族也参与了此事，对方损真派人前来，定然也是神帝强者。
若到时天妖族一同出手，对自己等人来说无疑是雪上加霜，江尘越想神色越凝重。
得到自己想要的消息后，江尘大手一挥抹杀了影魔族一众族人。
处理完影魔族这些人后，江尘回头看向江宇二人，神色凝重道：“我等必须助小天一手，让他完美掌控天道压制。”
“只有将来犯外域生灵修为压制到极境半步神帝境，我等才足够安全。”
江尘此言一出，江道心连忙回道。
“二哥，需要我等做什么尽管开口，我等定然会全力配合。”
江宇也是认同的点了点头。
江尘深呼吸一口气，抬头朝着天穹看了一眼，随即对着江宇二人道：“想让小天短时间内掌控天道压制，只能借助本源了。”
“大哥，三弟，我需要你们三成本源。”
三成本源并不是小数目，短时内缺失三成本源，对修士来说是莫大损失，不仅会陷入虚弱状态，根基也会因此受到影响。
然而听完江尘的要求后，江道心二人却没有任何异意，他们没有丝毫迟疑，当即从体内分出三成本源。
仅数息时间，江宇二人手心处便各自出现一团拳头大小的金色光团。
而这金色光团，正是分出的本源。
随着这金色皇团一出现，无论是江宇还是江道心，气息都萎靡了一大截，面色更是变是煞白如纸。

好在二人底蕴足够深厚，他们连忙运转功法稳定气息，面容恢复了些许血色。
“二哥，给你。”
江道心手掌轻轻一挥，本源光团直奔江尘二人。
江尘伸手接住江宇二人本源光团后，也是从体内分出三成本源，而后他将三团本源融合在一起，直接送入天穹。
江尘提前给小天打过招呼，因此本源光团刚升空不久，小天凝聚的天道之眼便在头顶浮现。
content_en:
Facing the roar of the powerful leader of the Shadow Demon Tribe, Jiang Chen did not respond. With a thought in his mind, the power of the soul that surged towards the opponent was once again strengthened.
"Ah..."
Under the crazy impact of the power of Jiang Chen's soul, the leader of the Shadow Demon clan screamed miserably, but his voice became smaller and smaller, and his eyes gradually became dull.
After a while, the leader of the Shadow Demon Clan stopped screaming, and his eyes became hollow, looking like a walking corpse.
After learning that there was a restriction in the opponent's soul, Jiang Chen gave up the method of soul searching. He directly used the power of his own soul to attack the opponent, causing him to fall into a state of trance.
In such a state, Jiang Chen could get the news he wanted with just a little guidance from the power of his soul.
After glancing at the leader of the Shadow Demon Clan, Jiang Chen asked in a deep voice: "What are the major gods and demon forces looking for with such a big fanfare?"
As soon as Jiang Chen asked, a slightly stiff voice came from the mouth of the leader of the Shadow Demon Clan: "We are looking for the strong man of the Sky Demon Clan."
Hearing this, Jiang Chen looked surprised.
In the original battle with the God Lord, the Sky Demon Tribe lost two elders of the God Emperor Realm, and in the end, their bodies were taken away by the elders of the Spirit Tribe. Unexpectedly, they would send people again so soon.
After thinking about it for a moment, Jiang Chen understood.
The two elders of the God Emperor were killed in the Shenlan Immortal Realm. The other party would definitely not give up. It was normal to send people up, but Jiang Chen did not expect it to happen so quickly.
When Jiang Daoxin and the two heard that it was related to the Sky Demon Clan, their expressions became serious.
Jiang Chen continued to ask: "Why are you looking for the Sky Demon Clan? Do you want to cooperate with them to deal with us?"
The strong man from the Shadow Demon Clan shook his head and replied: "We are looking for the Celestial Demon Clan because we want to surrender our name to the Black Dragon Clan."
"The Wood God Clan has contacted the Black Flood Dragon Clan and plans to use the power of the Black Flood Dragon Clan to attack you and others. The reason why they are looking for the Sky Demon Clan is because they are the Black Flood Dragon Clan's mortal enemies."
"Clear news has come out from the Wood God Clan. The Black Dragon Clan has sent three powerful God Emperors this time. They will soon arrive at the Shenlan Immortal Realm. All the major forces want to show off..."
In his absent-minded state, the strong man from the Shadow Demon Clan did not hide anything and told Jiang Chen all the information he knew.
"What, three powerful God Emperors?"
As the leader of the shadow demon tribe finished speaking, Jiang Daoxin couldn't help but exclaimed.
Jiang Daoxin was shocked when a black dragon clan suddenly jumped out and used three powerful God Emperors at once.
Even though Jiang Chen couldn't remain calm after hearing the news, Xiao Tian had just taken control of the Shenlan Immortal Realm, and the Heavenly Suppression was not fully under control.
The three powerful God Emperors are coming. When they enter the Shenlan Immortal Realm, their power will probably not be weakened too much.
If the other party can still display the cultivation of the God Emperor, it will be a disaster for himself and others.
Even if the three of Jiang Chen and the three powerful divine emperors from outside the territory condensed their divine patterns, they might not be able to do anything to each other.
What's more, the Sky Demon Clan is also involved in this matter. The other party, Zuzhen, who sent people here must also be a powerful God Emperor.
If the Sky Demon Clan takes action at that time, it will undoubtedly make things worse for him and others. The more Jiang Chen thinks about it, the more serious his expression becomes.
After getting the news he wanted, Jiang Chen wiped out all the members of the Shadow Demon Clan with a wave of his hand.
After dealing with the Shadow Demon Clan, Jiang Chen looked back at Jiang Yu and the two of them, and said solemnly: "We must help Xiaotian and let him perfectly control the suppression of heaven."
"Only when the spiritual cultivation of those who commit crimes in the outside world are suppressed to the extreme level of half-step of the God Emperor, will we be safe enough."
As soon as Jiang Chen said this, Jiang Daoxin quickly replied.
"Second brother, if you need anything from me, just ask and we will definitely cooperate fully."
Jiang Yu also nodded in agreement.
Jiang Chen took a deep breath, raised his head and glanced at the sky, and then said to Jiang Yu and the others: "If I want Xiaotian to control the suppression of Heavenly Dao in a short time, I can onlyWith the help of the source. "
"Eldest brother, third brother, I need your three sources. "
Three cost sources are not a small number. The loss of three cost sources in a short period of time is a great loss for the monks. Not only will they fall into a weak state, but their foundation will also be affected.
However, after listening to Jiang Chen's request, Jiang Daoxin and the others had no objections. They immediately separated the three sources from the body without any hesitation.
In just a few breaths, a golden ball of light the size of a fist appeared in the palms of Jiang and Yu's hands.
And this golden light group is the source of separation.
As soon as the golden imperial group appeared, both Jiang Yu and Jiang Daoxin's auras became much weaker, and their complexions became as white as paper.
Fortunately, the two of them had deep enough background. They quickly ran their exercises to stabilize their auras, and some color returned to their faces.
"Second brother, here you go. "
Jiang Daoxin waved his hand lightly, and the original light ball went straight towards Jiang Chen and the two of them.
After Jiang Chen reached out to catch Jiang Yu's two original light groups, he also separated three sources of light from his body. Then he fused the three sources together and sent them directly into the sky.
Jiang Chen had greeted Xiaotian in advance, so not long after the original light group took off, Xiaotian's condensed Eye of Heaven appeared above his head.
